title: Doppler Line Width
description: Essential Criteria - The response must define the Doppler line width and relate it to the temperature of the source.

title: Natural Line Width
description: Essential Criteria - The response must define the natural line width and connect it to the uncertainty principle.

title: Doppler Free Method
description: Important Criteria - The response should describe the double-photon absorption method and explain how it achieves Doppler-free measurements.

title: Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria - The response must include the energy relation for double-photon absorption and how it relates to Doppler shifts.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The response should avoid common errors such as incorrect definitions or failing to mention the relationship between temperature and Doppler broadening.
